title: Role Shadow Accelerator: gap analysis + training grid (wip)
body:
Overview:
This doc is a working proposal for a 14-day Role-Shadow Accelerator designed to rapidly surface skill gaps, create a lightweight training grid, and formalize a short mentor contract so new hires (and internal role-shifters) can reach effective autonomy faster. Intended audience: people-ops, hiring managers, mentors, and hiring pods running rapid onboards.

Why we need it (problem statement):
- Current 30–90 day playbooks are comprehensive but slow to iterate; many hires sit in ambiguous shadow periods where expectations and outcomes aren’t explicit.
- We want an experimental short-format accelerator that focuses on: 1) exposing practical gaps early, 2) pairing targeted micro-training activities, 3) committing mentors and mentees to clear evidence-based outcomes.

Goals / success metrics (hypothesis):
- Hypothesis: a focused 14-day shadow + training sprint reduces time-to-first-meaningful-PR/feature by 25% and increases new-hire confidence (self-reported) by 20 points on our onboarding survey.
- Metrics to track: time to autonomy (first code review approved or product demo), mentor/mentee satisfaction score (1–5), number of closed knowledge gaps from the training grid, attrition signals in first 90 days.

Scope / who this is for:
- Target roles: mid-senior ICs in Engineering, Solutions Eng, and small Product pods who require cross-domain knowledge quickly (not for exec hires or contractors).
- Scale: pilot 6 hires across 3 pods in Q1, then iterate.

14-day itinerary (compressed):
Day 0 (pre-start) - admin: ensure repo access, slack invites, workspace, basic accounts; mentor assigned and pre-read shared.
Day 1 - Observe: 2hr paired shadow (mentor leads), 1hr sync to align expectations, quick gap-analysis survey (mentee self-score).
Day 2 - Hands-on simple task: small docs/code task with mentor review; update training grid row for observed gaps.
Day 3 - Focused micro-training (1–2hrs): recorded short session + practice.
Day 4 - Paired deep-dive: 3hr pairing session on a live workflow.
Day 5 - Checkpoint: evidence submission (small PR/demo), mentor feedback.
Day 6-7 - Independent work applying learned skill; mentor available office hours.
Day 8 - Mid-sprint sync: revisit training grid, re-score skills.
Day 9 - Cross-team touchpoint: meet one adjacent owner (infra/product/release).
Day 10 - Training refresh + test (simulate incident or customer ask).
Day 11 - Lead a small demo or fix; gather peer reviewers.
Day 12 - Final gap triage; prepare 30d follow-up plan.
Day 13 - Handoff doc + async retrospective.
Day 14 - Final demo and evidence pack; survey and sign-off (mentor + manager).

Training grid (CSV-style inline for quick copy/paste):
Skill,Current,Target,Activity,Owner,Evidence
"Repo navigation",2,4,"guided repo walkthrough + take-home task","Mentor: Liam","PR #12, demo video 5m"
"Release checklist",1,3,"shadow release + checklist completion","Mentor: Sofia","Release runbook updated, checklist ticked"
"Support triage",3,4,"paired triage session + incident playbook review","Mentor: Ethan","Incident postmortem contribution"

Gap scoring rubric (quick):
- 1 = observed risk (cannot perform without help)
- 2 = requires step-by-step guidance
- 3 = can perform with minor questions
- 4 = independent, minor coaching
- 5 = ready to mentor others

Mentor contract (short form):
- Commitment: 3–5 hrs/week dedicated during the 14 days (plus scheduled pair sessions).
- Availability: 2 x 1hr office hours blocks per week; responses within 24 hours for critical blockers.
- Evidence: provide at least 2 concrete pieces of evidence (PR, runbook edits, recorded demo) before sign-off.
- Feedback cadence: daily quick async check-ins + formal mid-sprint and final syncs.
- Escalation: if mentee is blocked >48hrs, escalate to manager and people-ops for immediate remedial plan.

Assessment checklist (to be filled by mentor and mentee):
- [ ] Accounts and access validated
- [ ] First small task completed and reviewed
- [ ] Training grid updated (all observed gaps logged)
- [ ] Mid-sprint rescore done
- [ ] Evidence pack produced (links)
- [ ] 30d follow-up plan created

Evidence pack minimal contents (what to include in final folder):
- link to 2 PRs or code diffs
- 5–7 minute demo recording (screen + voice)
- training grid CSV export + before/after scores
- quick mentor note (2–3 bullets)

Template mentor note example (copyable):
"Mentee: NAME | Role: TEAM | Days paired: X
Top 3 observed gaps: 1) repo navigation, 2) release checklist, 3) incident triage
Progress notes: completed initial PR (link), independently led one small release step.
Recommendation: continue 30d micro-goals: pair on two releases, own one on-call triage run, complete cross-team docs.
Signed: Mentor name/date"

Pilot logistics / ops items (TODOs):
- [ ] Identify pilot pods and mentors (target 6 mentees) - owners: Maya + Liam
- [ ] Create a shared google sheet to track training grids (consolidated) - owner: People Ops
- [ ] Hook onboarding survey to Dev Pulse for pre/post metrics - owner: Analytics (JIRA-HR-312)
- [ ] Create a recording template + hosting link for demo videos - owner: DX team

Open questions / risks (notes):
- Risk: mentor burnout if too many mentees; mitigate by capping at 1:1 or 1:2 max for pilot.
- Question: should we compensate mentor hours as part of manager capacity planning? (finance consult)
- Note: some pods require deeper domain training; this accelerator must link to longer-term 30/60 plans.

Iteration plan / next steps after pilot:
- Run pilot Jan week 2–6, gather metrics, hold retro.
- If hypothesis validated, integrate accelerator as optional "fast-track" route in onboarding catalog; build small micro-learning library for the most common gaps.

Meeting notes (quick cadence planning):
- Weekly sync with mentors during pilot: Tue 9:30–10:00am (standing) - first meeting 2026-01-13
- Retro: 2 weeks after pilot end - all mentors + people-ops + analytics

Related references/links: see linked_artifacts above for baseline artifacts (confluence, jira).

Quick retrospective template (for mentees):
- What felt most helpful?
- What was missing?
- One concrete improvement for the next accelerator cohort?

Status: WIP — looking for feedback from hiring managers and 2 volunteer mentors. Please comment inline or ping me (Maya) in #people-onboarding.

-- end --
